verdict.rationale: Motion's docs describe multiple AI-driven insight/suggestion features generated from user data: highlighting the #1 priority based on analyzing all work, proactively flagging at-risk tasks/projects, predicting project completion dates from capacity data, and an AI search assistant/workflow builder that surface information and automate processes. These are first-party documented, product-wide capabilities rather than a single narrow feature. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of insight accuracy or usefulness, and no evidence of conversational or generative analytics (e.g., natural-language querying of data) beyond rule-based prioritization/alerts.
